facts.text: The party must bring Warwick the smith metal from the Dwarven mine to the north; in exchange Warwick keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre and plays it every night while they are gone to ward off his night visitors.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's heirloom armor, to him; he holds Sir Phidipaldi's plate armor and lyre as collateral until it comes back.
Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan, over his leather armor: it greatly improves his protection and halves the damage he takes from magic weapons and spells.
A natural-looking cave-in seals the Dwarven mine's entrance, blocking access to the metal for Warwick; it can be dug through, and Dunk has already bashed into it.
